title: VirSME Implementation | From Workflow Demo to Controlled Rollout
description: Understand the workflow-led process from discovery and configuration to commercial agreement, onboarding and controlled rollout.
hero: Change the operating system without stopping the operation.
intro: VirSME is sold through a consultative workflow-led process, not a generic self-service trial.

blocks.text: Bring one real process and show us where the friction exists.
We map the people, systems, records, rules, approvals and desired outcome.
We define the proposed VirSME scope, configuration and commercial terms.
Both sides agree the scope and terms. There is no generic pilot period before commitment.
Prepare the required data, user structure, permissions and operating rules.
Introduce the agreed workflows and users in a controlled manner.
Extend VirSME into additional workflows and capabilities as the business is ready.
